(6) sudo -u oracle bash -c "mkdir -p /tmp/patches && unzip -q /tmp/p37960098_190000_Linux-x86-64.zip -d /tmp/patches/". (7) sudo -u oracle bash -c "ORACLE_BASE=/u01/app/oracle /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1/runInstaller -silent -ignorePrereqFailure -responseFile /tmp/db_install_custom.rsp -applyRU /tmp/patches/37960098 -waitforcompletion".
